grain: One row per recorded in-game event.
modeling_notes: Event-level source for granular outcomes; aggregate by player/club and strictly respect event date.

grain: One row per national team; mostly a current/latest scraped snapshot.
modeling_notes: National-team snapshot; current values/rankings are not historical unless separately dated.

grain: One row per player valuation observation date.
modeling_notes: Time-stamped financial series. Nearest valuation on or before transfer can be a feature; later valuations can define financial return at a fixed horizon.

grain: One row per player; current/latest attributes are snapshot fields.
modeling_notes: Player identity dimension. Birth, citizenship, foot, position, and height are useful; current club, contract, current value, caps, goals, agent, and last_season may reflect a later snapshot and can leak.

grain: One row per recorded player movement between clubs on a transfer date.
modeling_notes: Likely modeling-event spine. Includes future-dated and non-fee movements, so scope rules are required. Zero fees may mean free transfer, loan, return, or undisclosed rather than a true zero purchase price.
